headline: As of 2026-10-26: 28,830,632 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 47 of 50 states, D+11.2 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 28,830,632 early/mail ballots cast so far across 47 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+11.2 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (4,426,276), California (3,160,419), Florida (2,803,308).
